title: bugClass
responsibility: Finds sibling bug sites in a committed revision, revalidates security candidates under explicit limits, and prepares confirmed repairs for regression proof.

inputs.name: committedSourcePaths.root
inputs.description: Absolute repository path for the source and Git state.

inputs.name: committedSourcePaths.revision
inputs.description: Commit hash of the source being evaluated.

inputs.name: committedSourcePaths.ranges
inputs.description: Optional map of source paths with changed line ranges to consider.

inputs.name: committedSourcePaths.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal for Git tree enumeration. When omitted, the normal Git command timeout applies.

inputs.name: patternHits.path
inputs.description: Source path that selects the applicable syntax parser.

inputs.name: patternHits.source
inputs.description: Committed source text to search.

inputs.name: patternHits.patterns
inputs.description: Literal text, call, or constructor patterns with ranking weights.

inputs.name: readBugClasses.tree
inputs.description: A readable source snapshot pinned to one Git commit.

inputs.name: registeredBugClass.tree
inputs.description: A readable source snapshot pinned to one Git commit.

inputs.name: registeredBugClass.id
inputs.description: Class identifier committed to the selected snapshot.

inputs.name: recordBugClass.root
inputs.description: Absolute repository path for the source and Git state.

inputs.name: recordBugClass.bugClass
inputs.description: Reusable root cause, evidence criteria, and source search patterns.

inputs.name: recordBugClass.revision
inputs.description: Commit hash of the source being evaluated.

inputs.name: reviewCandidates.candidates
inputs.description: Ranked candidate sites with source context for the evaluator.

inputs.name: reviewCandidates.bugClass
inputs.description: Reusable root cause, evidence criteria, and source search patterns.

inputs.name: reviewCandidates.evaluate
inputs.description: Semantic evaluator used to validate candidate and acceptance verdicts.

inputs.name: reviewCandidates.options
inputs.description: Evaluator model and maximum candidate sites to review.

inputs.name: redactSource.source
inputs.description: Source excerpts or evidence text to check for recognized credential patterns.

inputs.name: reviewKnownClasses.input
inputs.description: Repository, base ref, optional head revision, evaluator model, and review limit per class.

inputs.name: reviewKnownClasses.evaluate
inputs.description: Optional evaluator. Defaults to the authenticated Codex evaluator.

inputs.name: scanCandidates.tree
inputs.description: A readable source snapshot pinned to one Git commit.

inputs.name: scanCandidates.bugClass
inputs.description: Reusable root cause, evidence criteria, and source search patterns.

inputs.name: scanCandidates.options
inputs.type: { root: string; ranges?: Map<string, SourceRange[]>; origin?: { path: string; line: number }; reviewLimit: number; signal?: AbortSignal; checkDeadline?: () => void; }
inputs.description: Repository path, optional diff ranges and original site, review limit, and optional cancellation signal and deadline check.

inputs.name: sourceLayout.tree
inputs.description: A readable source snapshot pinned to one Git commit.

inputs.name: siblingBugSweep.input
inputs.description: Repository, optional commit, bug report or class ID, optional original site, model, and review limit.

inputs.name: siblingBugSweep.evaluate
inputs.description: Optional evaluator. Defaults to the authenticated Codex evaluator.

inputs.name: initSecurityReview.root
inputs.description: Repository root where the attack-surface and security-class starter files belong.

inputs.name: beginSiblingReport.root
inputs.description: Absolute repository path for the source and Git state.

inputs.name: beginSiblingReport.loop
inputs.description: Existing loop that receives the report.

inputs.name: beginSiblingReport.runId
inputs.description: Unique invocation identifier used for the report and repair refs.

inputs.name: beginSiblingReport.output
inputs.description: Source report and optional initial repair results.

inputs.name: requireSiblingReport.root
inputs.description: Absolute repository path for the source and Git state.

inputs.name: requireSiblingReport.loop
inputs.description: Loop whose sibling step is completing.

inputs.name: requireSiblingReport.filename
inputs.description: Filename of the recorded sibling report in the loop directory.

inputs.name: siblingReportComplete.report
inputs.description: Scan with evaluator errors, skipped files, and any requested repair results.

inputs.name: prepareSecurityRepair.root
inputs.description: Repository whose current HEAD must match the review revision.

inputs.name: prepareSecurityRepair.reviewPath
inputs.description: Path to the saved security revalidation report.

inputs.name: prepareSecurityRepair.findingId
inputs.description: Stable candidate ID of the uniquely confirmed finding to repair.

inputs.name: prepareSecurityRepair.budget
inputs.description: Deadline shared by report loading, commit verification, and repair preparation.

inputs.name: repairSiblings.report
inputs.description: Ranked source report and semantic evidence for the pinned revision.

inputs.name: repairSiblings.options
inputs.description: Repository, run identifier, authorized test command, and worker model.

inputs.name: repairSiblings.dependencies
inputs.description: Optional worker runner and independent evaluator.

inputs.name: repairSiblings.onResult
inputs.description: Optional callback to persist accumulated outcomes after each repair.

inputs.name: scanSecurityClass.input
inputs.description: Repository root, revision to pin, registered security class ID, and maximum reported candidates.

inputs.name: scanSecurityClass.budget
inputs.description: Deadline shared by Git reads and candidate enumeration. Scanning makes no reviewer reservations.

inputs.name: SecurityReviewBudget.constructor.limits
inputs.description: Positive duration in milliseconds and a nonnegative spending limit in whole millionths of a US dollar.

inputs.name: SecurityReviewBudget.reserve.maximumMicrousd
inputs.description: Verified positive maximum cost of one reviewer invocation in whole millionths of a US dollar.

inputs.name: revalidateSecurityScan.root
inputs.description: Repository containing the scanned commit and its committed security scope.

inputs.name: revalidateSecurityScan.scanFile
inputs.description: Path to the saved security scan report, checked against a repeat scan of its pinned commit.

inputs.name: revalidateSecurityScan.reviewer
inputs.description: Manual decisions file or absolute executable path with a verified maximum cost per external invocation.

inputs.name: revalidateSecurityScan.budget
inputs.description: Run deadline and spending limit shared by the repeat scan and independent revalidation.

inputs.name: readSecurityJson.path
inputs.description: Path to the UTF-8 JSON document to load and parse.

inputs.name: readSecurityJson.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal for reading the file. Defaults to no cancellation signal.

inputs.name: enableRepairProof.root
inputs.description: Absolute repository path for the source and Git state.

inputs.name: enableRepairProof.cwd
inputs.description: New detached worktree for the candidate.

inputs.name: enableRepairProof.id
inputs.description: Stable candidate ID used to name its proof loop.

inputs.name: recordFailingRepair.input
inputs.description: Isolated checkout, candidate, repair ref, and authorized test command.

inputs.name: recordFailingRepair.runner
inputs.description: Worker runner for the isolated checkout and phase-specific prompt.

inputs.name: recordPassingRepair.input
inputs.description: Isolated checkout, candidate, repair ref, and authorized test command.

inputs.name: recordPassingRepair.parent
inputs.description: Commit holding the already observed failing regression.

inputs.name: recordPassingRepair.runner
inputs.description: Worker runner for the isolated checkout and phase-specific prompt.

outputs.name: bugClassId
outputs.description: Schema for a stable kebab-case class identifier.

outputs.name: searchPatternSchema
outputs.description: Schema for one literal or syntax pattern and its rank weight.

outputs.name: bugClassSchema
outputs.description: Schema for the root cause, criteria, search patterns, and ranking hints.

outputs.name: classRecordSchema
outputs.description: Schema for a persisted bug class and its originating Git revision.

outputs.name: candidateVerdictSchema
outputs.description: Schema for a site ID, disposition, impact rating, and textual evidence.

outputs.name: candidateReviewSchema
outputs.description: Schema for one bounded batch of candidate verdicts.

outputs.name: repairReviewSchema
outputs.description: Schema for the independent accept or reject decision with evidence.

outputs.name: workerTestSchema
outputs.description: Schema for test paths and the expected literal failing assertion.

outputs.name: readBugClasses
outputs.description: Resolves with all valid classes committed to the supplied tree.

outputs.name: registeredBugClass
outputs.description: Resolves with the selected committed class, or rejects if its record is missing or invalid.

outputs.name: recordBugClass
outputs.description: Resolves with the relative registry path, retaining an identical existing class.

outputs.name: committedSourcePaths
outputs.description: Resolves with matching tracked regular source paths and their blob sizes.

outputs.name: reviewCandidates
outputs.description: Resolves with ranked sites and explicit diagnostics for failed evaluator batches.

outputs.name: reviewKnownClasses
outputs.description: Resolves with the pinned base and head, per-class reports, and gate verdict.

outputs.name: scanCandidates
outputs.description: Resolves with candidate sites, scanned file count, and skipped paths.

outputs.name: sourceLayout
outputs.description: Resolves with common extensions, directory prefixes, and present framework configs.

outputs.name: patternHits
outputs.description: Line-based matches for each supplied literal or syntax pattern.

outputs.name: siblingBugSweep
outputs.description: Resolves with the class, scan revision, ranked sites, and evaluator batch errors.

outputs.name: beginSiblingReport
outputs.description: Resolves with the report filename and a callback to persist later repair outcomes.

outputs.name: requireSiblingReport
outputs.description: Resolves when the current commit has complete required sibling evidence.

outputs.name: siblingReportComplete
outputs.description: Whether the scan succeeded and every requested confirmed repair was accepted.

outputs.name: repairSiblings
outputs.description: Resolves with attempted repairs for confirmed sites, preserving each outcome.

outputs.name: enableRepairProof
outputs.description: Resolves after preparing an isolated loop for the candidate proof.

outputs.name: recordFailingRepair
outputs.description: Resolves with the test-only commit and its observed failing regression record.

outputs.name: recordPassingRepair
outputs.description: Resolves with the separate repair commit and unchanged passing regression record.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Disallowed input, an invalid snapshot or class, incomplete evidence, or failed regression admission rejects the affected operation.
